newsitem.title: USA: NGC CORP EXPECTS FIRE DAMAGED PLANT IN SERVICE TUESDAY.
newsitem.headline: NGC CORP EXPECTS FIRE DAMAGED PLANT IN SERVICE TUESDAY.

text.p: NGC Corp said Monday that a fire Saturday morning at its Venice, Louisiana, gas processing plant shut the facility but it was expected back in service Tuesday.
The company said in a statement that the fire was confined to one of three processing heaters.

"All gas tied to the plant is being rerouted around the facility. No offshore natural gas producers have been curtailed," the statement said, adding the plant was processing about 750 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas.
The company is investigating the cause of the incident.
NGC does not expect the closing of the plant to have a material impact on earnings.
